contexts.text: Blindness thence is signified by the people of the north ().
By means of scientifics unknown to the ancients they blind themselves much more.
When worldly matters are the chief thing they reason from them about heavenly things and blind themselves.
(Self love and the falsities it suggests) blind them to such a degree...
They who have blinded themselves by believing nothing but what they apprehend by the senses...
(That light untempered) would blind all in Heaven.
(Worldly and bodily ends) blind men completely.
Because a gift blinds those who have their eyes open () = that gains cause truths not to appear.
Such are more blinded than enlightened when they read the Word...
Without this light and heat the internal of man would be blinded and chilled...
If they want to enter into them by means of natural lumen there meets them a kind of thick darkness which blinds them...
Nothing blinds man but his proprium and the confirmation of falsity.
No one can be reformed in a state of blindness of the understanding. General article.
To blind the eyes of the wise () = that they should not see or understand truth.
